description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldDatePicker class, which extends SugarWidgetFieldDateTime and provides a displayInput method to render an HTML date picker input with associated JavaScript calendar setup. It is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling date input widgets.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldDatePicker
classes.description: A widget class that renders a date picker input element with associated calendar setup.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript necessary to display a date picker input field, formatted according to the user's locale settings and including a calendar icon for triggering a date selection widget.
